lore:
"What's the number one rule of picking potion ingredients?"
"Nope, not the newest meta recipe. Not the premium-grade mats. Not even measuring properly."
"It's proximity."
"Same effect? Then grab whatever's closest. Fewest cabinet doors. Fewest corks. That's the whole system."
As for how she knows it'll still work? That part lives somewhere in Vivian's galaxy-brain talent for magic.
Don't ask her to explain it. She can't.
